source: User-supplied cosmos_web_starmask_jwst.tar.gz, 20 FITS tiles, 30mas native pixel; no WHT download and no MAST requery.
method: For each FITS tile, aggregate native 30mas binary mask into 10x10 pixel blocks, transform sky position with FITS PC/TAN WCS into Lambert equal-area coordinates, then deposit masked fractional area by bilinear area weights onto 0.3arcsec and 0.6arcsec grids. In overlapping sky cells, max(per-tile fractional mask) and min(1,sum(per-tile fractional mask)) form approximate lower/upper union-mask area estimates. Rasterization and fractional cell assumptions mean these are not rigorous exact-sky bounds.
conservative_report_as: approximately 0.013 square degrees of unique masked sky (rough raster sensitivity range 0.0128 to 0.0131 square degrees); not the overlap with F444W WHT or multi-epoch geometry
limitations: Masked pixels outside the usable WHT footprint have not been excluded.
Sky-cell overlap max/sum bounds are approximate because grid deposition and WCS resampling are not an exact native-pixel geometric union.
A 30mas native-pixel exact conservation or offset sensitivity test should precede subpercent scientific claims.
Confirm mask pixel 1 means excluded in COSMOS2025 documentation.
The mask data are not a completeness function: F444W=26.2, blue-filter non-detections, F356W SNR, and near-neighbor deblending are separate.
The 0/125 source-center-in-mask result remains unchanged; a source PSF/aperture can overlap the mask even when its center is unmasked.
Source binary tar.gz is a conversation attachment, not hosted in GitHub.
